optimization_notes: The monthly total includes all six manifest environment lines, ten Private Endpoint hourly charges, aggregate Private Link data processing, five shared private DNS zones and one million shared private DNS queries.
Private DNS zone cost assumes no pre-existing zones count toward the billing scope's first-25 tier; governance discovery may identify central zones and change the allocation or tier.

Reservation savings are a comparison against the on-demand baseline and are not deducted from monthly_total. The $508 one-year reservation term total is divided by 12; the official App Service pricing page's different-region monthly comparison corroborates the conversion only.
savings_reason: For the production Linux P0v3 plan only, the swedencentral 1 Year Reservation row from the same-day Azure Resource Manager MCP response reports retailPrice=USD 508 and reservationTerm=1 Year; Microsoft Learn Retail Prices API documentation states reservation retailPrice is the term total. Monthly equivalent=$508/12=$42.33333333. Compared with this estimate's P0v3 on-demand cost of $64.97/month, savings are $22.63666667/month ($271.64/year), or 34.84%. The official App Service Linux pricing page's $62.050/month pay-as-you-go versus $42.384/month 1-year reservation figures corroborate the term conversion but are a different-region reference, not the priced source. B1 is not reservation-eligible. P1v3 had no reservation row in the prior fresh swedencentral response and was not queried again.
